verdict.rationale: Grok Build can run commands, subagents and monitors in the background while the conversation continues. Subagents run as independent child sessions, worktree sessions run in isolated repo copies, and a Landlock/Seatbelt sandbox restricts the agent. The dashboard tracks which agents are working or done. All of this runs locally, though, and nothing in the evidence shows delegating tasks to a hosted, isolated cloud environment. missing for 10: cloud-hosted execution environment, remote/asynchronous task delegation that survives closing the local session, hands-on corroboration of long-running background delegation.
